basisChange.integralReason: K is an integral matrix with determinant one, so K inverse is integral and W lies in GL(24,Z)

meaning: All 24 Haldane-null interwire terms become channel-diagonal in an allowed integral compact-boson basis.
boundary: A GL(24,Z) field redefinition simplifies the continuum vertex operators but does not guarantee that a chosen microscopic platform implements the transformed K inverse kinetic couplings or exposes the new fields as spatially local hardware modes.
